game_concept: A action defense set in Eldritch Ruins – Relic Vault, a hidden relic vault: the rune scholar must handle stone sentinels while practicing lists. Core idea – Slice Slicer: Cut lists with slices like items[1:4] to grab exactly the right group.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Relic Vault: a hidden relic vault
core_gameplay_loop: In Relic Vault, repeat each round: Cut lists with slices like items[1:4] to grab exactly the right group. Each round, stone sentinels strike the moon altar, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the slice_ok value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the moon altar from stone sentinels in Relic Vault: keep the slice_ok meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 57-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: slice_ok drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 57-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 10 (extended tier): Slice Slicer
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Slice Slicer' (Week 7 slot 3), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Relic Vault'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how slice_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against stone sentinels in Relic Vault.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 57 seconds while slice_ok > 0.
